label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be _____: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verse: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
note: Isaiah's short song of thanksgiving — it echoes the very words Moses sang after the Red Sea crossing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Give us this day our _____ bread.
verse: Give us this day our daily bread.
note: From the Lord's Prayer: ask for today's bread, not a year's supply — like manna, tomorrow's comes tomorrow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he found a new _____ of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
verse: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
note: Samson's weapon of choice was a fresh jawbone of a donkey — he even wrote a little victory poem about it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God _____ of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
verse: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
note: The question Micah would echo centuries later: what does God actually want? Fear, walk, love, serve.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There _____ therefore a rest to the people of God.
verse: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
note: 'There remaineth therefore a rest' — a Sabbath-rest for God's people that the land of Canaan only previewed.
